segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Dana, thanks for jumping on. I know we're trying to lock down the support package before your September 16 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, so, we can do 42 seats to start, but I need clarity on the invoice timing. Finance doesn't want a surprise annual bill landing before the PO clears.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. For 42 seats on the standard plan plus onboarding, you're at $38,640 annually, and the onboarding is a one-time $4,500. We can set invoice issuance for October 1, net 30, assuming the order form is signed by September 12.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. I sent you the security questionnaire last Thursday and didn't hear back, so I was a little worried this was going sideways.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, fair. Honestly, last week got eaten up by clerical stuff on my end. I spent almost all of Wednesday and Thursday typing updates into the CRM, cleaning duplicate account records in the database, fixing seat-count fields, and assembling the internal deal desk paperwork so finance would approve the discount. It crowded out time I should have been using to actually talk with you and the other buyers, which is not where I want to be. I did finish your questionnaire though, and I can walk through the two items that needed notes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. The two items were data retention and admin access, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right. Retention is 18 months by default, but your admins can request deletion earlier. For admin access, we support role-based permissions, and your team can limit billing visibility to the three finance users.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. On the contract, can we do a 12-month term, not 24? We may add the claims team in Q1, but I can't commit now.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, 12 months is fine. I can hold the 8% discount at 42 seats, and if you add the claims team before February 28, we'll co-term those seats to the same renewal date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send the order form with October 1 billing, net 30, 42 seats, and the 12-month term. If legal doesn't redline anything weird, I can get signature by Friday.
